Traffic advisory on HWY-25 Both Directions Near Township Road 140. Speed Restriction: 80km/hr Activities: Speed reduction, Rough road, Drive with caution
Comments: Highway 25 between the junction with Highway 526 and Highway 521, north of Turin - deteriorating road conditions and pavement breakup. Expect a speed reduction and drive with caution.

Landslide on HWY-744 Both Directions Near Range Road 214. Speed Restriction: 50km/hr Activities: Lane closure, One - lane alt traffic, Speed reduction, Temp traffic signals, Follow Directions
Comments: Highway 744 approximately 400 meters south of Sagitawa Lookout, south of Peace River - road realignment due to a slide in the area. Expect one-lane alternating traffic controlled by temporary traffic signals with a speed reduction to 50 km/h. Obey all posted signage and drive with caution.

Rough Road on HWY-25 Both Directions from HWY-521 to HWY-526 . Speed Restriction: 80km/hr Activities: Speed reduction, Rough road, Drive with caution
Comments: Highway 25 between the junction with Highway 521 and Highway 526, north of Turin - deteriorating road conditions and pavement breakup. Expect a speed reduction and drive with caution.

Road Breakup on HWY-40 Both Directions Near Sheep Creek Rd. Speed Restriction: 80km/hr Activities: Speed reduction
Comments: Highway 40, 34.5 km north of Grande Cache - pavement failure. Bump signs are in place with a speed reduction to 80 km/h.

Traffic advisory on HWY-58 Both Directions 1.07 Km Beyond Imperial Dr. Activities: Drive with caution
Comments: Advisory: This is a private road and beyond this point is not under the care or control of Alberta Transportation. The road is not regularly maintained and conditions may be unfavorable for travel. Travel at your own risk.
